title: Boss part 1: rank the dock rows

ticket.subject: Sort the dock rows
ticket.body: Each row is (dock, name, kg). Sort the rows by dock, A to Z. Within a dock, the heaviest parcel comes first. Parcels with the same dock and weight go by name. Return "dock/name" strings in that order.

rules: Sort the rows by dock, A to Z.
Within a dock, the heaviest parcel comes first.
Parcels with the same dock and weight are ordered by name.

title: Boss part 2: dispatch by priority

ticket.subject: Dispatch order
ticket.body: Each job is (priority, name). A lower priority number goes first. Jobs with the same priority go in the order they arrived. Return the job names in dispatch order.

rules: A lower priority number goes first.
Jobs with the same priority keep their arrival order.

title: Boss part 3: flatten the tags

ticket.subject: Flat list of tags
ticket.body: Tags arrive in nested lists of any depth. Return one flat list of the tags, in the order they appear. Empty lists add nothing.

rules: The tags keep their left-to-right order.
Lists nested at any depth are flattened.

title: Boss part 4: the dock report

ticket.subject: Report lines
ticket.body: Each row is a (dock, total kg) pair. Return one line per dock, sorted by dock name A to Z. Each line reads "dock: total kg", with the total to one decimal place.

rules: Each line reads "dock: total" with the total to one decimal place.
Lines are sorted by dock name, A to Z.
